name: Progress M-43
about: Progress M-43 (2000-064A), a crewed vehicle (Progress M), launched 2000 Oct 16. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2000 Oct 17), held fixed
